Welcome! This site collects training materials created by **NV OSE, the Office of State Epidemiology**, for public health staff and anyone else who wants to learn. All materials are free to use and share under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

## Trainings

| Training | What you'll learn | Level | Time |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Introduction to Git and GitHub](pages/intro-to-github/index.qmd) | Git vs. GitHub, READMEs, .gitignore, GitHub Desktop, the command line, branches, pull requests, forks, public vs. private, and data security | Beginner | About 3 hours |

More trainings are on the way.

## How to use these materials

- **Self-paced:** work through the lessons in order using the sidebar, then try the exercises.
- **Workshop:** instructors can teach directly from the pages. Each training lists its learning objectives, prerequisites, and timing.
- **Get the files:** all source files are on [GitHub](https://github.com/nv-ose/training). You can [download everything as a ZIP](https://github.com/nv-ose/training/archive/refs/heads/main.zip).

## Share a training

**NV OSE staff:** have materials you'd like to see here? [Submit a training](https://github.com/nv-ose/team-hub/issues/new?template=training-submission.yml) (sign-in required). Attach your slides, handouts, or code, and we'll turn them into pages on this site.

::: {.callout-note}
These pages never contain real data. Examples use made-up or public data only.
:::
